text: The stylelint follow-up removes a global media-query-no-invalid exemption and adds next-line waivers for Gecko preference queries. Current code uses -moz-pref, not the older -moz-bool-pref spelling, while keeping local waivers. Preserve the exception at the actual unsupported engine syntax and leave unrelated query checking enabled. max-nesting-depth is already lint configuration and is not taught as a new manual rule. This is static source evidence. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.
title: Keep an engine-specific CSS waiver at the affected query
